## File: facebookresearch_perfect/fewshot/metrics/metrics.py

Prompts

```
['compute the average accuracy between predictions and targets as a percentage score', 'compute whether predictions match targets exactly and return an exact match score', 'compute the average exact match score grouped by question id from extra_info', 'compute the macro-averaged F1 score between predictions and targets as a percentage', 'compute the default F1 score between predictions and targets as a percentage']
```

Usage

```
{'accuracy': 'compute the average accuracy between predictions and targets as a percentage score', 'exact_match': 'compute whether predictions match targets exactly and return an exact match score', 'group_exact_match': 'compute the average exact match score grouped by question id from extra_info', 'f1_macro': 'compute the macro-averaged F1 score between predictions and targets as a percentage', 'f1': 'compute the default F1 score between predictions and targets as a percentage'}
```
